description:
Get a summary/overview of a project from Holded.

Args:
  - project_id (string): The project ID to get summary for (required)
  - response_format ('json' | 'markdown'): Output format (default: 'json')

Returns:
  Project summary including projectEvolution, profitability, economicStatus, and task statistics.

project_id.description: The project ID to get summary for

response_format.description: Output format: 'json' for structured data or 'markdown' for human-readable

name: holded_projects_get_project_summary
title: Get Holded Project Summary
